serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
The Elite Enterprise Solutions (Elite) SaaS offering is a supply 
chain management platform designed for distribution organizations 
across various industries, including healthcare, service parts, 
heavy equipment, industrial goods, and third-party logistics (3PL). 
It offers an integrated suite of enterprise solutions to optimize 
supply chain operations, improve efficiency, and enhance 
customer service. The Elite offering includes the following core 
modules: 
• Warehouse Management
• Transportation Management
• Delivery Management
• Distribution ERP
• Billing Management
For healthcare organizations, the Elite system includes these 
additional modules:
• Point of Use
• Pharmacy Inventory Management
• Healthcare Supply Chain Management
Built on the Itopia® platform, which adapts to organizational growth 
and complexity, Elite is highly customizable and ideal for 
organizations seeking a comprehensive, scalable supply chain 
solution that provides end-to-end supply chain visibility and 
compliance.
Elite is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as 
well as research institutions, federal contractors, government 
contractors etc.
